The '''C5D construction droid''' was a model of [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droid]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Yasinda Bardak]], a Senior Executive for [[TranStar Construction]], owned one of these droids.<ref name="J15" />
